operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: Flotilla Activists in Israeli Custody Allege Torture; Appear in Israeli Court
heroSubtitle: Activists from the Global Sumud Flotilla held in Israel appeared in court May 3, alleging torture and mistreatment in Israeli custody following the IDF interception of the flotilla in international waters. 168 of 175 detained activists were disembarked in Crete on May 1; those taken to Israel now face legal proceedings. 11 nations issued joint condemnation of the interception. Cumulative death toll: 72,587+ since Oct 7, 2023; 824 killed since Oct 2025 ceasefire; Phase 2 talks deadlocked.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, and Haaretz. Gaza death toll: 72,587+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023 (Gaza Ministry of Health / WAFA). 824 killed since Oct 10, 2025 ceasefire framework per OIC Palestine Observatory (Apr 28, 2026). ICC arrest warrants issued for Netanyahu and Gallant (Nov 2024). Board of Peace established Jan 2026 under UN Resolution 2803. UN ASG Khiari (Apr 28, 2026): ceasefire 'increasingly fragile'; 1.8M displaced. UN Women (Apr 25, 2026): 38,000+ women and girls killed Oct 2023–Dec 2025 (avg. 47/day). EU-UN Joint Recovery and Reconstruction Assessment (Apr 21, 2026): $71.4B needed over 10 years; $35.2B infrastructure damage; 371,888 housing units damaged/destroyed; human development set back 77 years. Global Sumud Flotilla (58+ vessels from Barcelona) intercepted by IDF Apr 29–30 in international waters ~600 nautical miles from Gaza — farthest IDF interception on record. 175 activists detained; 168 disembarked in Crete (May 1); 2 taken to Israel for questioning. Spain, Turkey, Brazil, and 8 more nations issued joint condemnation; Spain summoned Israeli chargé d'affaires. 11 nations signed joint condemnation statement. Red Cross field hospital medical equipment confirmed entering Gaza (May 1). 2026 Flash Appeal $4.1B req, only 9.7% funded. Hamas Phase 2 disarmament deadlocked; Israel controls ~60% of Gaza. ICRC warning: humanitarian response on verge of collapse after 2-month aid blockage from Feb 28, 2026.
